# CANDIDATE: VIX_FILTER_FOR_BEARISH_REJECTION

**Filed:** 2026-09-08  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The base engine loses on 4/29 and 5/01 because VIX was below 20 and not rising, violating the BEARISH_REJECTION setup's VIX confirmation filter. Adding a VIX filter (VIX >= 20 OR rising) avoids these losing entries while preserving the 5/04 winner. This aligns with the playbook's VIX confirmation rule for bearish setups.

## Mechanism

Add a pre-entry filter: BEARISH_REJECTION entries only trigger if (VIX >= 20) OR (today's VIX > previous day's VIX). Uses the same entry trigger, stop, and target logic as BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON. VIX value pulled from real-time quote at evaluation time. No changes to exit logic or position sizing.
